target: Flatten R-series runtime hook chain into functional modules and a single dispatcher without changing protected runtime behavior.
next: Validate VR-REFACTOR-STATE-0002A in CI, then consolidate duplicate R22/R31 StateBlock interception ownership as VR-REFACTOR-STATE-0002B without changing draw semantics.
notes: Current hook graph is pinned as a ceiling, not as the desired final architecture.
Future refactor commits may reduce legacy hook counts but must not increase them without explicit review.
VR-REFACTOR-STATE-0002A centralizes R22/R31 StateBlock reliability, coverage-loss and lazy-resync authority while preserving physical hooks, cache invalidation and final-draw ordering.
Aggregate StateBlock reliability requires both R22 and R31 producers plus intact coverage, preventing premature R31 fast-path trust.
